usage: 飲茶 can be used as a noun to refer to the meal or occasion involving eating dim sum and drinking tea.
飲茶 can also function as a verb phrase meaning 'to have dim sum' or 'to go for dim sum'.
When used as a verb phrase, 飲茶 usually comes after a subject and before any time expressions.
The phrase 飲茶 is commonly used in casual conversation and refers specifically to this Cantonese cultural dining experience.
You can say '我哋一齊飲茶' to invite someone to have dim sum together.
